# Prabal Raj Shakya

> Digital Marketing Specialist based in Kathmandu, Nepal. I do SEO, technical audits, answer engine optimization (AEO), paid social, email automation and short-form video. I lead SEO and website strategy at GSA Contract Services.

This site is a personal portfolio and blog. Guides are written by Prabal Raj Shakya and show their last-updated date and sources.

## Blog posts

- [On-Page SEO: What to Fix on a Page Before You Chase Links](https://www.prabalrajshakya.com.np/blog/on-page-seo/): On-page SEO explained with a clear checklist: titles, headings, content, internal links and images, plus how it differs from off-page and technical SEO.
- [What Is the 3-3-3 Rule in Marketing?](https://www.prabalrajshakya.com.np/blog/what-is-the-3-3-3-rule-in-marketing/): The 3-3-3 rule in marketing uses three content types, three distribution channels, and three buyer journey stages to build a simple growth framework.
- [Is SEO Dead With AI? What Actually Changes in 2026](https://www.prabalrajshakya.com.np/blog/is-seo-dead-with-ai/): Is SEO dead with AI? No, but the tactics that earn visibility changed. Here's the direct answer: what AI Overviews changed, what to drop, and what still ranks in 2026.
- [What is SEO and how does it work?](https://www.prabalrajshakya.com.np/blog/what-is-seo-and-how-does-it-work/): A direct, plain-language answer covering how search engines crawl, index and rank pages, the main types of SEO, and where to start as a beginner.
